label: Faloni
aesthetic: Relaxed Italian knitwear: knit polos, linen/camp shirts tucked into pale trousers, suede loafers or mules.
signature_pieces: pleated or drawstring trouser in stone/cream/olive, falling naturally over the shoe

min_signals.why: at least 2 of: Faloni top (knit polo/linen/camp), pale or linen trouser, suede loafer/mule

banned.why: No boots, runners or fashion sneakers; tassels read Polo/IW.
A clean leather sneaker only on Weekend/Travel/Comfy.
Heavy, loud and street tops are off-brand (zip knits and henleys are 545).
No structured, workwear or technical outer.
No linen or camp collar in winter.

pairing_rules.why: A chambray/denim shirt goes only with pale trousers (no double denim).
Jeans only with a signature Faloni top.
A plain shirt or polo needs a suede loafer or mule to read Faloni rather than Polo.

weekday.modifier: Knit polo tucked into pale pleated trousers + suede loafer

out.modifier: Linen/camp or knit polo + cream/ivory trouser + mule/loafer

winter.modifier: Fine knit + wool trouser + suede loafer; no linen (FAL-B5)

card_note: Relaxed Italian knits: knit polo or linen, pale trousers, suede loafers.
gap_note: No silk-cotton knit polos labelled as such: brown/yellow knit polos stand in.

must_differ.italiansummer: Faloni = no jacket, may use mules; IS needs a soft jacket or a fully tonal core, and a mule only with a jacket.
must_differ.545: Faloni uses pale trousers + suede loafers; 545 uses denim/relaxed dark trousers and zip knits.

scoring.empty_state: Always has looks in spring/summer; in winter show the closest look + the gap note.

gaps: Knit polos are few (Brown knit polo g_bq9qnaa1vkon, Pale yellow ribbed polo g_9eip7wdtsxzd, Burgundy collared sweater g_xbt3gpjuo1p4, Green herringbone knit shirt g_zh2l854ghu1t).

current_code_scoring: houses.ts Faloni: required tokens (knit polo/linen + pale trouser + suede loafer/mule), plus a palette_lane token that fires from 'cream' in garment NOTES (24 plates have 'A cream sheet…' pipeline text). lookFitsOccasion HAS a faloni Weekday branch. The fingerprint is so loose that grey knit + sage pleats + grey sneakers passes Faloni Weekend.
